ansible.builtin.copy.content:
# The StreamStack voice chain: a PipeWire filter-chain that exposes "StreamStack Mic" (48 kHz mono).
# The Console starts the same host by itself; enable this unit only to have the voice chain without the Console:
#   systemctl --user enable --now streamstack-audio-chain.service
[Unit]
Description=StreamStack voice chain (StreamStack Mic)
After=pipewire.service wireplumber.service
Wants=pipewire.service

[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/streamstack chain run
# StreamStack Mic becomes the default microphone once the host is up, and the raw one comes back when it stops.
ExecStartPost=-streamstack chain claim-default
ExecStopPost=-streamstack chain release-default
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=3
Nice=-5
NoNewPrivileges=true

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target

# StreamStack deck: an Elgato Stream Deck as a control surface for the Console, with the Console closed.
# `streamstack deck enable|disable|status`, or the Deck page. Needs the deck extra: pip install 'streamstack[deck]'.
[Unit]
Description=StreamStack deck (Elgato Stream Deck keys for the Console)
After=graphical-session.target
StartLimitIntervalSec=300
StartLimitBurst=5

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/streamstack deck run
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
Nice=5
CPUWeight=10
NoNewPrivileges=true
# The deck starts a headless Console when none is running; that Console must outlive a restart of this unit.
KillMode=process

[Install]
WantedBy=graphical-session.target

ansible.builtin.template.rendered:
# Managed by the curiosity workstation role (streamstack task group).
# The StreamStack Console without a window: it hosts the native video engine
# (the only writer of the program camera, /dev/video43
# "StreamStack Camera") and starts the voice chain ("StreamStack Mic").
# `streamstack console` opens a window on this same process.
# Runs for these accounts only: one account at a time may feed the camera.
[Unit]
Description=StreamStack Console (native video engine and voice chain, headless)
After=graphical-session.target pipewire.service wireplumber.service
Wants=pipewire.service
ConditionUser=|mrh
StartLimitIntervalSec=300
StartLimitBurst=5

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/streamstack console --no-window
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
NoNewPrivileges=true
# The engine's ffmpeg child dies with the Console; stop the whole group together.
KillMode=control-group
TimeoutStopSec=20

[Install]
WantedBy=graphical-session.target

ansible.builtin.template.rendered:
# Managed by the curiosity workstation role (streamstack task group).
# StreamStack Camera (/dev/video43 "StreamStack Camera") is a v4l2loopback node with exclusive_caps=1: until the
# Console writes it, it offers only output capability. WirePlumber probes the node when udev announces it (module
# load at boot) and never again, so PipeWire, Firefox and the camera portal do not list it until WirePlumber
# probes it a second time. After the Console has fed the node, this one-shot asks `streamstack camera-publish` to
# restart WirePlumber once. It refuses while an app holds the camera or captures audio (exit 3), so a call is never
# interrupted. See StreamStack#176 and docs/camera-delivery.md in the application.
[Unit]
Description=Publish StreamStack Camera to PipeWire (one WirePlumber restart after the Console feeds it)
After=graphical-session.target pipewire.service wireplumber.service streamstack-console.service
Wants=streamstack-console.service
ConditionUser=|mrh

[Service]
Type=oneshot
# A StreamStack release without `camera-publish` makes --help fail: the unit is skipped, not failed.
ExecCondition=/usr/local/bin/streamstack camera-publish --help
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/streamstack camera-publish --wait 120
# 3 = an app holds the camera or captures audio: nothing to do now, and not a failure.
SuccessExitStatus=3
TimeoutStartSec=180
NoNewPrivileges=true

[Install]
WantedBy=graphical-session.target

set -o pipefail
for _ in $(seq 1 30); do
  pactl list short sources | cut -f2 | grep -qx streamstack_mic && break
  sleep 2
done
pactl list short sources | cut -f2 | grep -qx streamstack_mic || { echo "streamstack_mic absent"; exit 3; }
if [ "$(pactl get-default-source)" = streamstack_mic ]; then echo unchanged; else
  pactl set-default-source streamstack_mic && echo changed; fi
